claims.claim: Every admissible set on an exhaustively listed argument carrier extends to a preferred set.
claims.hypotheses: The list contains every argument, and the starting set is admissible for the supplied attack relation.
claims.finite_checks: The grounded runner fixtures exercise a different semantics. Preferred-extension existence follows from this theorem.
claims.source_review: Abstract argumentation. Juristic interpretation of preferred extensions remains open.
claims.refinement: Existence in the Lean relation. An executable preferred-extension enumerator would require its own correctness theorem.

claims.claim: The checked runner rejects malformed edges. A successful run gives the least complete extension on Fin n.
claims.hypotheses: The input is a finite vertex count and list of attacks. The checked runner verifies both endpoints.
claims.finite_checks: UsulTest.KernelContracts exercises invalid endpoints, cycles, duplicate edges and a defense chain.
claims.source_review: Abstract argumentation. The attack list and its completeness come from the caller.
claims.refinement: The theorem refers to the Lean runner. External parsers and attack extraction require separate verification.

claims.claim: A trace is admissible exactly when the supplied premises hold and the requested result equals the evaluator result.
claims.hypotheses: The caller fixes the reading and supplies any command context, qarina admissibility and imitation evidence required for that request.
claims.finite_checks: UsulTest.KernelContracts exercises missing external premises and positive conditional admission.
claims.source_review: The M5 readings remain candidates and the source interpretation questions remain open.
claims.refinement: The proof links the Lean trace and evaluator. Live evidence authentication and authority require separate verification.

claims.claim: Jam takes priority. Suspension occurs exactly when jam, naskh and preference all yield no result. A preference winner is one of the supplied positions.
claims.hypotheses: The caller supplies the candidate positions, policy, proof tiers, comparative advantages and any jam or naskh outcomes.
claims.finite_checks: UsulTest.Reconcile checks generated ledger cases under the declared policies.
claims.source_review: Evidence admission, chronology and search completeness are separate source obligations.
claims.refinement: The theorem refers to the Lean resolver. Corpus adapters have differential evidence within their tested scope.

claims.claim: A successful modeled history admits at most one execution. Each accepted execution has authority at its pre-state and is identified by the final receipt.
claims.hypotheses: The run starts at initial. The execution witness theorem assumes the specified event has executionCount equal to one.
claims.finite_checks: The Agency gate compares all 13,312 finite transition inputs with Quint and runs scenarios and semantic controls.
claims.source_review: The two revocation profiles and mixed knowledge composition remain candidate readings in docs/research/agency-source-profile.md.
claims.refinement: The proof covers the modeled histories. Concurrent application authorization and durable execution require a separate refinement theorem.

claims.claim: A presented conclusion holds in every history satisfying the destination premises. The synthetic baseline has a compatible candidate and its exact conclusion is false in history zero.
claims.hypotheses: The view contains a Pilot receipt. Conditional soundness requires satisfaction of the destination premises in the history. The countermodel fixes the synthetic baseline plan and histories.
claims.finite_checks: The case-workbench gate compares 384 hypothetical cells with Quint and checks a separate source-bound synthetic baseline.
claims.source_review: The fixture uses synthetic source passages and synthetic authorities. Live case interpretation and approval remain separate.
claims.refinement: The Lean view presents the admitted receipt. Host comparison and browser checks provide bounded implementation evidence.

claims.claim: Typed substitution retains occurrence identity and profile; scoped projection retains occurrence identity and evaluator agreement. The unresolved agency definition and mismatched occurrence certificates are refused. The finite native applications admit and have compatible histories.
claims.hypotheses: General laws use typed inquiries, substitutions and valuations, or well-formed scoped projection inputs. Certificate refusal assumes membership and an occurrence mismatch; changed-context replay assumes unequal catalogues. Native admissions fix the supplied synthetic authority and histories 1 or 2.
claims.finite_checks: The dedicated structural gate compares 81 rows and 585 cells with independent Quint, pins 17 explicit proposition contracts, and runs 12 tests, five semantic mutants, compiled axiom controls and a proposition-weakening control.
claims.source_review: The exact agency.revoke proposal remains candidate and unresolved. Repayment applications, authority and histories are synthetic; report-observation results do not establish report truth.
claims.refinement: The claims concern the stated Lean structures and bounded comparison. They do not establish real evidence authentication, general schema or profile migration, or full ACT-08 acceptance.

claims.claim: For the five-valued Hukm carrier, mutual Reads and identical applicability and projection can coexist with different answers under sigma, while mubah is fixed. A nonempty consistent known list admits a globally factoring extension for each of the five answers on an unattested feature class. The existing De Morgan lattice is not Boolean: mubah fails both Boolean complement laws, only the endpoints admit complements, and a Boolean binding predicate loses ruling distinctions.
claims.hypotheses: The relabeling witness fixes a partial encoder with a Hukm feature and Hukm answers, Boolean applicability and noise coordinates, and the actual IDA.sigma answer map. Applicable answers differ exactly away from mubah. The extension witness fixes four Boolean feature/noise cases and two known cases with feature false and answer wajib. The generic unattested_free result is instantiated for arbitrary answer : Hukm under explicit consistency and absence hypotheses. Algebra claims concern the existing ordered Hukm lattice and its operations.
claims.finite_checks: The ACT-03 gate appends 20 relabeling, 100 extension and 25 fivefold algebra rows to the original scope/report table: 3,537 rows and 32,008 cells total. It pins 21 named boundary contracts, rejects three terminal theorems weakened to True, runs five Quint tests, rejects twelve semantic mutants and nine malformed exports, and distinguishes all five ruling wire tags from optional-answer absence.
claims.source_review: The cases and their assigned Hukm values are synthetic mathematical controls using the actual deontic carrier. They make no assertion about a source passage, a real act, or the correct answer under a juristic interpretation. Applying sigma as an answer map does not itself establish a valid omitted-act inquiry or its evidence.
claims.refinement: The witnesses delimit information dependence, finite supplied-case determination and the boundary of Boolean projections. Mubah remains a definite ruling, distinct from unknown or inapplicable answers. The controls do not establish a unique interpretation, source authenticity, evidence admission, or full ACT-08 acceptance.
